title: Principles of Emergency Management
cross_references: Agencies Working Together as One Integrated Team

nodes.text: Primacy of life: Protection and preservation of human life takes priority

evidence.source_text: Primacy of life - The protection and preservation of human life, including the lives of both agency personnel and those of the community, takes priority over all other considerations.

nodes.text: Community centric: Focus on impact, outcomes, and support to the community

evidence.source_text: Community centric - The community and individual community members will be at the core of everything we do. Focussing on the impact, outcomes and support to the community underpins decision making and actions undertaken in planning and responding to all hazards.

nodes.text: Unified: Work together to achieve common objectives as one team

evidence.source_text: Unified - Working together to achieve common objectives as one team with the community, government and business before, during and after emergencies.

nodes.text: Progressive: Anticipation and continual improvement to predict and respond

evidence.source_text: Progressive - Anticipation, foresight and continual improvement to predict, prepare, plan and respond to likely, unexpected and worst case scenarios.

nodes.text: Risk driven: Actions and investments are prioritised by risk

evidence.source_text: Risk driven - Our actions and investments are prioritised by risk. Sound risk management, involving risk assessment (identification, analysis and evaluation), treatment and ongoing monitoring, is applied to the assigning of priorities and resources.

nodes.text: Integrated and collaborative: Unity of effort towards shared outcomes

evidence.source_text: Integrated and collaborative - Unity of effort towards achieving shared outcomes founded on a willingness to work together, share responsibility and act with respect, integrity and trust developed through teamwork and strong relationships.

nodes.text: Flexible: Adapt and apply creative approaches to solve challenges

evidence.source_text: Flexible - Being agile and adapting and applying creative and innovative approaches in responding to and solving the challenges of emergencies.

nodes.text: Communicating information: Provide clear, targeted information for effective management

evidence.source_text: Communicating information - Providing clear, targeted and tailored information to those that need it and those at risk.
These principles are not in priority order; they are all critical to the effective management of emergencies.
